pages.commitMessage:
fix(affiliate): tie the runtime tag list to the map; retract the metering finding

TWO FIXES AND ONE RETRACTION.

1. lint:affiliate now derives its class-tag alternation from AFFILIATE_TAGS
   instead of hardcoding the three IDs in a regex. The tags were written in
   three places: the map, Layout.astro, and this linter's own pattern.

2. New check: Layout.astro's runtime AFFILIATE_TAGS array must state the same
   set as src/data/affiliate-tags.ts. That array decides whether an outbound
   click is TRACKED AT ALL, it cannot import the module (it is an is:inline
   script shipped unprocessed), and nothing tied the two together. A stale
   array records zero affiliate clicks site-wide while looking healthy.

   Verified the gate fires: simulating the 2026-08-13 stale-array state
   produces "runtime AFFILIATE_TAGS is MISSING tcaaccessory-20, tcachair-20,
   tcadesk-20" and exits 1. A gate that cannot fail is decoration.

3. RETRACTION — the index-monitor "metering gap" reported earlier today is NOT
   real. index-monitor.ts calls meteredCreate only from fixPage(), which runs
   only for pages the classifier marks fixable. Across all 12 reports in git
   history, zero rows ever carried a fixable fixType — every issue classified
   'wait'. The call has never fired, so zero cost-ledger records is correct.
   monday.yml does stage data/cost-ledger.jsonl, so the commit path was never
   the problem either. $20.55 is accurate, not a floor.

   The correction is appended to wiki/synthesis/decisions-log.md rather than
   silently editing the original claim.

Gates: build 55 pages · lint:affiliate 165 links ✓ · lint:content 55 ✓
